reviewNote: Compiled from the official sources named on each row on 2026-10-14. Not yet reviewed by a chartered accountant. Extended dates announced later by notification are not included.

rules.monthly: Due every month on `day` (or the last day of the month when `day` is "last"). `months` limits the calendar months it falls in; `overrides` replaces the day in a named month.
rules.annual: Due every year on each MM-DD in `dates` (quarterly returns list their four dates).

allMeans: A state list of ["all"] applies in every state and union territory.
